gen-syne-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab stands tall and grounded. Syne sketches every letter as one bent wire with no pinched curves, while Bespoke Slab's text serif brings lofty lowercase bodies and a refined steadiness.
gen-syne-fs-erode: Experimental meets dignified. Syne draws smooth, pressure-free lines that look like a single stripe of ink, whereas Erode lets its stroke swell and ebb, with a mild contrast that feels editorial.
gen-tourney-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Athletic and cut-sharp. Tourney stretches its letters wide with bulky small caps-like lowercase, while Mochiy Pop One, a plain sans with huge round lowercase eyes, hangs along the line like laundry and keeps paragraphs relaxed.
gen-ultra-fs-bespoke-sans: Vintage weight with a pressed-glass swell. Ultra keeps its letters tightly packed and its openings narrow like blade slots, and Bespoke Sans responds with generous space between curve ends and stems, so a long stretch reads crisp and easy.
gen-unbounded-fs-gambetta: Unbounded spreads wide. It pushes out oversized lowercase with a friendly c, while Gambetta's text serif holds a lower, moderate height and a visible but restrained shift between thick and thin strokes.
gen-unbounded-fs-hoover: Friendly, wide and contemporary. Unbounded sprawls with oversized lowercase, and Hoover, a refined serif with compressed ascenders and a generous entry into the e, carries a paragraph with a robust, steady grip.
gen-unbounded-fs-ranade: Friendly through and through, Unbounded spreads its oversized lowercase wide and opens every c with a broad welcome. Ranade's slight rubber-cord weight shifts are the quality that sets it apart.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-public-sans: Gothic and clustered, tightly knit. UnifrakturMaguntia towers with lofty lowercase, while Public Sans, a hefty sans-serif with broad open counters, settles into paragraphs with trustworthy, no-fuss ease.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-familjen-grotesk: Vintage and attention-grabbing. Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width with a tall mean line, while Familjen Grotesk, a lively sans with half-open bowls, keeps the lowercase tall and brisk beside it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-savate: Eye-catching and vintage, Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width with round letters as heavy as straight ones. Savate, a sans with sturdy hairlines and open curves, adds light contrast beneath.
